Muk

Poison

Kanto · Generation 1

Muk is a Poison-type Sludge Pokémon first found in Kanto (Generation 1). It stands 1.2 m tall and weighs 30 kg. It evolves from Grimer. Its highest base stat is HP (105), with a base stat total of 500.
